purpose.summary: Patient registration and insurance information management screen program (P02) for the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt software system. It handles patient basic information entry, insurance/public expense (hoken/kouhi) registration, validation, and related screen workflows. The program manages patient data including name, birthdate, address, insurance numbers, and various insurance type combinations.

verdict.notes: The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt software project for Japan. Comments are in Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but decoded as latin-1, producing garbled characters. The source is large (7360 lines, ~320KB) and clearly production-grade. The program_type is listed as batch but it likely drives a screen-based (character terminal or GTK) UI via the ORCA framework rather than CICS. No copybook-only content — full program with all four divisions present.
